'''Market Boulevard''' is an unnamed [[List of Street Names|street]] in [[Los Santos (3D Universe)|Los Santos]], [[State of San Andreas (3D Universe)|San Andreas]]. It stretches from [[Temple]] (north) to [[Verdant Bluffs]] (south).

==Description==
Market Boulevard starts in Temple at an intersection with [[Mulholland Drive]]. It then continues south through [[Market (3D Universe)|Market]], before ending in the northernmost portion of Verdant Bluffs. The boulevard gives easy access to areas such as [[Downtown Los Santos (3D Universe)|Downtown]], [[Commerce]], Market and [[Verona Beach]]. In addition to Mulholland Drive, Market Boulevard also intersects with [[Vinewood Boulevard (3D Universe)|Vinewood Boulevard]] and [[Fifth Avenue]].
